_comment: Run config for qedhtn_pipeline.py. Point each dataset at your real CSV and its fraud-label column. model='sklearn' runs anywhere; model='grafix' needs PyTorch and enables the component ablation. Every table is produced as mean +/- SD over `seeds` runs; nothing is hand-entered.
_max_cardinality: Caps each categorical column at its top-K categories before one-hot encoding (the rest bucket into __other__), so IEEE-CIS does not exhaust memory. 50 is a good default; override per dataset below, or pass --max-cardinality on the command line. Use 0 to disable.
